## What this letter says
Yusuf's asthma review appointment has been cancelled. The clinic has moved. He has a new appointment. He will see the Paediatric Asthma Nurse. This is in Children's Outpatients, Blue Zone.

## What you need to do
1. Do not go to the old appointment on 9 November 2026. It has been cancelled.
2. Go to the new appointment on 23 November 2026 at 09:15.
3. Bring all of Yusuf's inhalers. Bring his blue reliever inhaler (salbutamol). Bring his brown preventer inhaler (beclometasone).
4. Bring his spacer.
5. Bring his personal child health record (red book), if you have it.
6. Keep giving the brown preventer inhaler every day, even when Yusuf is well. Do not stop it when he seems fine.
7. If the new time is not suitable, call the Children's Outpatients Booking Office on 01632 960 588.

## Dates and medicines
- Old appointment: Monday 9 November 2026. It is cancelled.
- New appointment: Monday 23 November 2026 at 09:15. It is with the Paediatric Asthma Nurse, Children's Outpatients, Blue Zone.
- Beclometasone (brown preventer inhaler): the dose is not stated. Give it every day, even when Yusuf is well. No change. Keep giving it.
- Salbutamol (blue reliever inhaler): bring it to the appointment. The letter gives no dose or change.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- Where is the new clinic, and how do I get there?
- Can I book a different time if 09:15 does not suit me?
- Is there anything else I should bring to the appointment?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
